notes:
What's new in 0.1.135:
- Watch Together in the browser: a guest who joins a room no longer gets their own "Resume from ...?" question, which could hold the shared film at 0:00. The guest follows the room. The person who started the room still gets the normal question.
- Beebo is updating: when this PC is about to install an update, everyone watching from this PC (the browser player, and phones and TVs that understand the notice) is now told "Beebo is updating on the home computer. It will be back in a few minutes." The browser player keeps your place and carries on by itself once the computer is back. Beebo now stays open about 3 seconds instead of under 1 second after the installer starts when someone is watching, so the notice can arrive. A dropped connection with no such notice never says an update is happening. The notice says nothing about the update itself.
- Sharing with another household: this PC can now make a share code for the owner's own signed-in phone (the phone's "Share my library" screen, in the phone app) and show that code again for the share the owner made. Only the owner signed in on the phone can do this; the PC's admin web page cannot make or read share codes. An owner who loses admin rights while a request is being answered is noticed and gets nothing.
- Browser player, Cast button: after you tap Cast and Google's Cast script has loaded, the button's label and dimming follow what Google Cast reports. Only "no devices available" shows "No TV found". While a TV is connecting or connected the normal Cast label shows. Google's Cast script still loads only when you tap Cast.
- Settings search: you can now type a phrase. Every meaningful word has to match in the setting's name, description or search words, in any order, and small words (with, a, an, the, to, of, in, on, for, and, my, when) and punctuation are ignored. For example, "start with Windows", "Windows start" and "START, with WINDOWS!" all find the start-at-sign-in setting in Keep your server available. Searching one word works as before, and an empty box still shows everything.
- Behind the scenes (no change to how the app works): automated checks were added or updated for all of the above.
- Windows only. The phone app and Beebo Auto are separate releases.
- Automated checks: the full Windows desktop test suite (2,107 test files) was run on this release's code just before a last fix to the wording of its release notes: 2,062 files passed, 38 were skipped because they need tools or settings this PC does not have, or are switched off on purpose (not run), 3 failed only because of how the run was split and passed when run alone, 1 passed on its automatic re-run, and 4 failed because of a typing mistake in the new release notes, which was fixed and then passed along with the 27 test files that load that page. The change that lets a phone make a share code had two clear code reviews and each other change one. The signed installer passed its signature, size, converter, connection-helper and language checks. No person has installed this version or tried its in-app update yet.
- Release source commit 9e6cb9f70.
